text:
sarah: FYI escalated -- enterprise customer reported we removed access when they hit the cancel flow. Their call to /v1/autoroute invoked `plan.adjust` instead of `subscription.terminate`.
sarah: payload they sent:
```json
{"intent":"cancel","user_id":"acct_9X3","reason":"closing account","allow_prorate":false}
```
sarah: plan.adjust ran, returned 200, and downgraded plan instead of terminating. customer lost time, needs rollback and root cause.

james: /cc @meera - do we have recent changes to the autorouter heuristics? any rollout yesterday?
deploy-bot: deploy/autorouter v2.14.1 -> production at 2024-11-19T23:12:04Z (canary 100%); changelog: "heuristic: fuzzy-schema scorer improvements"

meera: grabbing logs. if plan.adjust and subscription.terminate share similar signatures we might have schema shadowing again. sending the router decision blob.

james: decision snippet from call trace:
```
chosen_tool: plan.adjust
confidence: 0.62
alt_tool: subscription.terminate
alt_confidence: 0.58
reason_weights: {"schema_overlap":0.45, "verb_match":0.10, "historical_routing":0.07}
```

alex: repro steps I used locally (no auth token shown):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/autoroute \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"intent":"cancel","user_id":"acct_9X3","reason":"closing account","allow_prorate":false}'
```
alex: I get same behavior: tool chooser selects plan.adjust. It returns {"status":"ok","action":"plan.adjusted","details":"downgraded to free"}

meera: root cause hypothesis: plan.adjust signature contains optional `allow_prorate` and `reason` fields too (for scheduled downgrades) so our fuzzy matcher weights schema overlap heavily when tokens like "plan" or "prorate" appear. cancel intent lacks explicit "terminate" verb in JSON body.

sarah: customer invoked via web UI -> backend sent intent="cancel" only. so missing explicit action verb seems common in web flows.

james: short-term mitigation: update routing rules to favor verbs in the top-level `intent` field when confidence gap < 0.1. I'll push a config tweak to staging, test, then prod rollback if green.

meera: medium-term: we should make `subscription.terminate` require a required boolean `immediate` field OR make it accept an explicit enum `action: [terminate, downgrade, pause]` so ambiguity is reduced.

alex: adding a unit test to autorouter/tests/test_tool_priority.py to cover this: send payload with intent cancel and assert chosen_tool == "subscription.terminate" after config change.

oncall-bot: ticket created: #SUP-4829 (high) - autorouter misrouted terminate -> plan.adjust. Owner: james. SLA: 24h.

sarah: customer is on enterprise contract, legal notified. please treat as P1. we need rollback & a mitigation for next 2 hours.

james: rolling config tweak to prod now (prefer_intent_verb: true when confidence_delta < 0.12). monitoring logs for 10 min.

meera: watch logs -- I see two recent autoroute calls where terminate chosen now. patch looks effective in staging; prod logs show immediate change for new calls.

sarah: can you also run a backfill to detect other recent calls where alternative was terminate and plan.adjust was chosen? need list for customer remediation.

james: on it. will dump last 48h where chosen_tool==plan.adjust and alt_tool==subscription.terminate and confidence_delta<0.15.

alex: adding repro + regression to the CI gate. once merged, won't allow fuzz scorer changes without a test.

sarah: thanks team. keep updates here. :eyes:
